about: NS-4 (gap closure, GAP-CLOSURE-PLAN.md section 4 G-NS; rule GD-b, section 7). Harness step E8.5 uploads every artifact below to the Evidence Collector with the uploader's principal (uploadedBy); step E8.6 has EO mint an approver token for the reviewer and posts one review per row to POST /api/reviews. Under GD-b a control with no stack source is met only when every NIST SP 800-171A objective has a met review by a reviewer who is not the uploader; one not_met review sets not_met. Rows under not_reviewed have no review (the artifact does not show that objective), so their control stays not_assessed. The probe artifact is uploaded and never reviewed: V80 checks its control stays not_assessed. Verdicts are the reviewer's reading of the artifact; edit them here, never in the harness. muster-partial is the regression tenant: it has no organisation records, so it has no review and only the probe upload.
